messages:
erin: RCA published for the recent serving regressions. Link: https://redwood.internal/rca/2267890123-serving-regressions
sam: thanks — solid write-up. question: does the service-level fallback policy change land during the mitigation?
maria: short answer: yes, temporary fallback-to-quantized disabled for affected pools until we validate KV cache behavior. noted in the doc under 'policy changes'. owner: @maria.
jae: I'll add an alert that fires if fallback is accidentally re-enabled in prod. PR planned today.
priya: prepping a customer note. Per the RCA, impact is "intermittent latency for heavy-context requests" — will keep wording minimal.
ops: please include exact rollback criteria in the canary notes so oncall can act quickly.
erin: added canary checklist and rollback bullets in the doc. snippet:
```
canary validation (8-12m)
1) replay 6m prod tail to canary
2) confirm p95 <= 480ms
3) eviction_rate <= baseline * 0.7
4) no increase in 5xx spike
rollback if p95 > 650ms OR error_rate delta > 0.5%
```
maria: scheduling canary for 01:45 UTC tomorrow. manual trigger. I'll post live metrics here. cc @ops @sre
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-02 01:45 UTC. Trigger: @maria. Targets: 12% of us-east pool.
comms-bot: Draft customer note available in the RCA doc under /communications. @priya please review and approve.
sam: assigning follow-ups in the doc: Maria run canary (due 2026-04-02), Jae alert PR (due 2026-04-09), Priya customer note (due 2026-04-04), Erin checkpoint sync (due 2026-04-06).
erin: i'll host a 30m checkpoint on Mon 2026-04-06 14:00 PT. invite sent. please add agenda items in the calendar entry.
ops: will join. if canary green, let's stage gradual rollout and monitor for 24h before full lift.
maria: kicking canary tomorrow and will post results. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
infra-bot: rca-published link=https://redwood.internal/rca/2267890123-serving-regressions tags=[reliability,policy,canary]
erin: final note: please comment inline on the RCA if you see missing context or alternate mitigations. we'll reopen the RCA doc if we discover new evidence.
